fact: At a briefing on 5 August 2026 the Inspection générale des finances presented a 2026-2028 plan whose architecture integrates AI algorithms to flag fiscal ineligibilities, duplicates and payment anomalies across DGI, DGDA, DGRAD and Treasury data; the system is described as to be built (financing 39.63 million USD).
title: RDC : comment l'Inspection Générale des Finances entend digitaliser la traque aux détournements
